## Close C1 {#closing minutes=0 kind=closing}

::: point {#C1.a band=Basic}
WHY-STATEMENT: why the number comes before the design.

::: proof
WHY-PROOF: a note on why the number came first.
:::

::: to-get-there {level=not-yet}
WHY-NOT-YET: read the Design Document.
:::

::: to-get-there {level=understand}
WHY-UNDERSTAND: explain it to a classmate.
:::

::: to-get-there {level=redo}
WHY-REDO: write it on your project.
:::
:::

::: point {#C1.b band=Solid}
WHERE-STATEMENT: where it comes from.

::: proof
WHERE-PROOF: a README linking the assumption and the line.
:::

::: to-get-there {level=not-yet}
WHERE-NOT-YET: read the Design Document.
:::

::: to-get-there {level=understand}
WHERE-UNDERSTAND: redo the guided calculation.
:::

::: to-get-there {level=redo}
WHERE-REDO: derive a number on your project.
:::
:::

::: point {#C1.e band=Outstanding}
LIMIT-STATEMENT: where the design stops holding.

::: proof
LIMIT-PROOF: the limit, written down.
:::

::: to-get-there {level=not-yet}
LIMIT-NOT-YET: read the number changes.
:::

::: to-get-there {level=understand}
LIMIT-UNDERSTAND: change one assumption.
:::

::: to-get-there {level=redo}
LIMIT-REDO: find your own limit.
:::
:::
